verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right (logo, eyebrow, headline, subhead, date, pills, can, RSVP) and keeps the original's order and pill row. Its flaws: the RSVP button is tiny and weaker than the headline, the logo wordmark, subhead and legal text are barely readable, the broken image placeholder is still in the far right corner, and the right third is crammed. B puts 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' below the headline and squeezes the subhead into a narrow block that crowds the can. It splits the date into a stacked fragment and drops the RSVP button into a 2x2 grid with the three tag pills, so the button reads as just another tag and the CTA is buried. The URL, legal text and placeholder are also jammed at the right edge.
